findings.current: The other young man, Jin Taekyung, had also claimed he would circulate his qi before promptly falling into a dead sleep.
findings.defect: The draft makes Taekyung similar in having claimed he would circulate his qi, but the source says the same combination of exceptional looks and talent also applies to him.
findings.rationale: The topic marked by 도 마찬가지다 refers back to the qualities Hyuk Mujin envies, while the intervening clause identifies Taekyung by his current behavior.
findings.replacement: The same went for the other young man, Jin Taekyung, who had said he would circulate his qi only to fall into a deathlike sleep.
findings.source: 운기조식을 할 거라더니 죽은 듯이 자고 있는 또 다른 청년, 진태경도 마찬가지다.

findings.current: *How can brothers look this much alike?*
findings.defect: “Look alike” narrows the resemblance to physical appearance, although the following lines extend it to talent and personality.
findings.rationale: 닮다 is broader here than visual resemblance and introduces the full list of shared traits.
findings.replacement: *How can two brothers be this alike?*

findings.defect: The draft weakens the coarse disgust in 개 같은 경우 and makes the complaint vague.
findings.rationale: The source uses a distinctly vulgar description of the situation, consistent with Hyuk Mujin's mounting resentment.
One 시진 is a traditional two-hour period, and 장장 emphasizes how long the scolding lasted.
findings.source: 다른 한 놈은 마차도 제대로 못 몬다며 장장 한 시진을 구박하더니 이젠 속 편하게 운기조식 중이다.

findings.current: “Really? I suppose it was immature. I only learned it superficially.”
findings.defect: The draft makes the technique itself “immature” instead of Mukyung admitting that his superficial study left him unskilled in using it.
findings.rationale: 미숙했나 보군 describes the speaker's lack of proficiency, causally attributed to 겉핥기식으로 익힌 것.
findings.replacement: “Really? I suppose I’m still unskilled at it, since I only learned it superficially.”
findings.source: “그래? 역시, 겉핥기식으로 익힌 거라 미숙했나 보군.”

findings.current:
Yet Jin Taekyung himself did not stir.

Haaah. Haaah.
findings.defect: “Haaah” reads as conscious sighing or panting rather than the quiet sleeping breaths that continue despite Mukyung's shout.
findings.rationale: 쌔액 represents steady sleeping or snoring sounds, which establish the repeated deadpan gag.
findings.replacement:
Yet Jin Taekyung himself did not stir.

Snnn. Snnn.

findings.defect: The repeated sound again suggests panting rather than Taekyung continuing to sleep through the blows.
findings.rationale: The unchanged sleeping sound after three smacks is the source's comic contrast.

findings.current: supposedly a First Rate martial artist
findings.defect: The draft drops 초, lowering Taekyung from the upper echelon of First Rate martial artists to an ordinary First Rate martial artist.
findings.rationale: 초일류 denotes a level above ordinary 일류 and matters to Mukyung's disbelief that such an accomplished martial artist remains unresponsive.
findings.replacement: supposedly a top-tier First Rate martial artist
findings.source: 이 정도면 내공 한 톨 없는 양민도 비명을 지르며 일어나야 하는데, 명색이 초일류의 무인에 산서잠룡이라는 놈이 꿈쩍도 안 한다.

findings.current:
*In all my life, I’ve never seen anyone so defenseless.*

And to think he was his younger brother.
findings.defect: The draft reverses the presentation of narration and direct thought: the narrated observation becomes an italicized first-person thought, while Mukyung's explicit thought becomes third-person narration.
findings.rationale: Only the second Korean sentence is marked as direct thought, and its first-person kinship reference must remain Mukyung's internal voice.
findings.replacement:
Jin Mukyung had never seen anyone so defenseless in all his life.

*And that guy is my younger brother.*
findings.source:
살다 살다 이렇게 무방비한 놈은 처음 봤다.

‘그리고 그놈이 내 동생이라니.’

findings.defect: Dropping Hyuk removes the immediate contrast with Mukyung's mistaken “Hyung Mujin” and Hyuk Mujin's correction.
findings.rationale: Taekyung deliberately uses the correct full name directly after Mukyung mangles it, which sustains the name-based joke.

findings.current: *Right. Fighting the moment I got back would be a little much, on a human level.*
findings.defect: “On a human level” is an unnatural literal calque that does not sound like Taekyung's conversational narration.
findings.rationale: 인간적으로 is a colloquial appeal to basic reasonableness here, not a reference to a literal human level.
findings.replacement: *Right. Come on, fighting him the moment I got back would be a bit much.*
findings.source: 그래, 인간적으로 오자마자 싸우는 건 좀 아니지.

findings.current: for the upcoming New Year’s Day.
findings.defect: “New Year’s Day” can imply January 1 and does not identify the traditional lunisolar holiday meant by 원단.
findings.rationale: 원단 denotes the first day of the traditional lunar year in this setting.
findings.replacement: for the upcoming Lunar New Year.
findings.source: 곧 다가오는 원단에 그들을 태원진가로 초대하십시오.

findings.current: The Mount Heng Sword Sect needed a new center of gravity, and one person emerged.
findings.defect: “Center of gravity” is a stiff literal calque for the person around whom the depleted sect could regroup.
findings.rationale: 구심점 is figurative here and naturally refers to a unifying leader or rallying point.
findings.replacement: The Mount Heng Sword Sect needed a new rallying point, and one person emerged.
findings.source: 항산검문은 새로운 구심점이 필요했고, 그렇게 한 사람이 등장했다.

findings.current: The last surviving blood relative of Lee Cheonbaek, and the current Sect Leader of the Mount Heng Sword Sect.
findings.defect: “Blood relative” broadens the kinship to any relative, while 핏줄 identifies Seowol as Lee Cheonbaek's last surviving descendant.
findings.rationale: The source describes continuation of Lee Cheonbaek's direct bloodline, not merely a surviving member of his extended family.
findings.replacement: Lee Cheonbaek’s last surviving descendant, and the current Sect Leader of the Mount Heng Sword Sect.
findings.source: 이천백의 마지막 남은 핏줄이자 현(現) 항산검문주.

findings.current: Hyuk Mujin looked at me with a thoroughly excited expression.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the visible cue of his flushed face with a generic emotional expression.
findings.rationale: 상기된 얼굴 specifically describes his face as flushed, while the context supports excitement as its cause.
findings.replacement: Hyuk Mujin looked at me, his face flushed with excitement.
findings.source: 혁무진이 잔뜩 상기된 얼굴로 나를 바라봤다.

summary: The draft contains one altered duration, several meaningful losses of characterization or hierarchy, misplaced narrative viewpoint, and localized register and terminology issues.
